properties.name: snodra.messaging.service-name
properties.description: Logical service name: the prefix of the processors' subscriptions, event source and hub registration name. Required.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.type-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of the wire type name of message classes without @MessageType. Required.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.instance-id
properties.description: This instance's id: its hub registration's instance id and the service.instance.id of its metrics. A fresh UUID per start unless set (a pod name, for example); unique among the instances of the service.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.enabled
properties.description: Connect to the hub and expose the hub-backed CommandBus and QueryBus.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.address
properties.description: The hub or hubs: one gRPC target (host:port, optional static:// prefix), a comma-separated list of them (one connection per hub), or one dns:///name:port re-resolved every 30 s.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.status-interval
properties.description: Period of the InstanceStatus report sent to every hub (must be positive).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.request-timeout
properties.description: Per-request timeout sent as timeout_ms. Unset: the hub applies its default or per-type override. 0s counts as unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.reconnect-backoff.min
properties.description: Initial reconnect delay when the hub stream drops; doubles per failed attempt, resets once an attempt reached the hub's handshake.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.reconnect-backoff.max
properties.description: Maximum reconnect delay when the hub stream drops; every wait is jittered by +-20 % and capped at this value (at the cap: 80-100 % of it).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.stream-credit-timeout
properties.description: Longest a streaming handler waits for credit from the collector before it ends the stream with TIMEOUT and frees its handler slot and hub permit. Must be positive; the default is the hub's default maximum stream duration.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.max-subscriptions
properties.description: Subscription queries this instance serves at once, over every hub (at least 1); the next one is refused with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. A subscription holds no handler permit, so max-concurrent-handlers does not bound it.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.token
properties.description: Static token sent in Register.credentials.token of every hub stream (hub access control, P5a). Optional; empty is the same as none. Never logged and redacted in toString and in the actuator configprops and env output. Environment variable SNODRA_MESSAGING_HUB_TOKEN, or SNODRA_SERVER_TOKEN when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.token-file
properties.description: File holding the hub token (a container secret), trimmed at both ends: read at startup, where an unreadable or empty file fails the startup, and again on every reconnect. Wins over snodra.messaging.hub.token when both are set. Environment variable SNODRA_MESSAGING_HUB_TOKEN_FILE, or SNODRA_SERVER_TOKEN_FILE when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.oauth2.token-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (for example https://<host>/realms/<realm>/protocol/openid-connect/token on an OpenID Connect provider). Setting it turns OAuth2 client-credentials authentication on (P5b, ADR 0019): the service registers with the access token as a jwt credential and renews it before it expires. http is allowed and warns unless the host is loopback or a single-label name. Cannot be combined with hub.token or hub.token-file. Environment variable SNODRA_MESSAGING_HUB_OAUTH2_TOKEN_URI, or SNODRA_SERVER_OAUTH2_TOKEN_URI when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.oauth2.client-id
properties.description: The confidential client's id, which is the azp of its tokens and must be the service name. Defaults to snodra.messaging.service-name. Environment variable SNODRA_SERVER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.oauth2.client-secret
properties.description: The client secret. Never logged and redacted in toString and in the actuator configprops and env output; prefer client-secret-file. Environment variable SNODRA_MESSAGING_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET, or SNODRA_SERVER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.oauth2.client-secret-file
properties.description: File holding the client secret (a container secret), trimmed at both ends: read at startup, where an unreadable or empty file fails the startup, and again on every token fetch, so a rotated secret applies without a restart. Wins over client-secret. Environment variable SNODRA_MESSAGING_HUB_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE, or SNODRA_SERVER_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.oauth2.scope
properties.description: scope of the token request, as sent (space-separated); none by default. Environment variable SNODRA_SERVER_OAUTH2_SCOPE when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.oauth2.ca-file
properties.description: PEM file with CA certificates to trust on top of the platform roots for an https token-uri (not the hub's CA: that is hub.tls.ca-file). Environment variable SNODRA_SERVER_OAUTH2_CA when this property is unset.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.tls.enabled
properties.description: Talk TLS to the hub, for every address form (static list and dns:///). Off: plain text.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.tls.ca-file
properties.description: PEM file with the CA certificate(s) that signed the hub's certificate; the JVM's system roots when absent. Read on every connection attempt.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.tls.server-name
properties.description: Name the hub's certificate is verified against instead of the address's host.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.tls.client-cert-file
properties.description: PEM file with the client certificate chain (leaf first) presented to the hub (mTLS). The leaf needs exactly one URI SAN snodra://service/<name> equal to the service name. Needs hub.tls.client-key-file, implies TLS, cannot be combined with a static token or OAuth2. Read at startup and on every reconnect; a renewed pair is adopted without a restart.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.tls.client-key-file
properties.description: PEM file with the private key of hub.tls.client-cert-file: unencrypted PKCS#8 (BEGIN PRIVATE KEY).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.max-concurrent-handlers
properties.description: Incoming hub requests handled concurrently by this instance; further requests wait for a free slot. Also announced as initial_permits to a hub with flow control, which queues the excess.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.load-factor
properties.description: Relative capacity of this instance (Register.load_factor, 100 = normal); weights its share of the hub's routing.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.tags
properties.description: Labels announced in Register.tags, for example zone=eu-1; unkeyed requests prefer instances whose tags match the sender's.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.priorities
properties.description: Default Request.priority per message type name (types not listed send 0); higher is served first when the hub queues requests.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.retry.enabled
properties.description: Retry failed sends that are safe to retry (see RetryClassification).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Total attempts including the first.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.retry.initial-backoff
properties.description: Wait before the second attempt.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Growth of the wait per further attempt.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.hub.retry.max-backoff
properties.description: Upper bound of a single wait; all attempts stay within the caller's timeout budget.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.event-store
properties.description: The event store's name (kafka, rabbitmq-streams, memory): which one runs when two event-store add-ons are on the classpath, and the only way to run the in-memory one (memory: not durable, one JVM; tests, local runs, demos). Unset: the only one there is.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.store.type
properties.description: The message store's name (mongo, jdbc, memory): which one runs when two are available, and the only way to run the in-memory one (memory: not durable, one JVM; tests, local runs, demos). Unset: the only one there is.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.memory.segments
properties.description: The in-memory event store's segments per source (1 to 1024): a key always goes to the same one; the competing instances of a subscription share them.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.events.source
properties.description: The source the service's events are published to and read from (a topic on Kafka).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.events.subscription-prefix
properties.description: The prefix of every event processor's subscription name; unset: the service name. Every processor, default included, uses <this prefix>.<name> (on Kafka the consumer group).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.events.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Run the event processors; set false in tools that only publish.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.events.consumer.max-attempts
properties.description: Handler invocations per record (first try included, 1 s apart) before the record goes to the dead letters (events.dead-letter.mode); shared by every event processor.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.events.dead-letter.mode
properties.description: What an event processor does with a record it cannot handle: collection (park it in the message store's dead letters, the default), event-store (publish it to the event store's <source>.dlt; needs the capability native-dead-letter) or log (log and skip).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.events.dead-letter.retention
properties.description: A dead letter is deleted this long after it was parked (TTL index on expireAt), which also unblocks its key; at least 1s.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Run the outbox publisher that relays the outbox entries to the event store.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.outbox.poll-interval
properties.description: Outbox publisher poll period.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Outbox documents per poll.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.outbox.retention
properties.description: Sent outbox documents older than this are deleted.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.outbox.max-attempts
properties.description: Send attempts per outbox document before it is marked failed (failedAt) and skipped.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.outbox.lease
properties.description: How long a batch the outbox relay claimed stays its own; another instance relays it only after that. Longer than one send (45s).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.store.init-schema
properties.description: Apply the message store's schema (indexes, tables) at startup. False when the service applies it itself.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.idempotency.retention
properties.description: processed_events documents older than this are deleted.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.security.forward-jwt
properties.description: Put the current request's bearer token in the hub request's authorization header.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.enabled
properties.description: Switch for the saga runtime, the dispatch relay and the deadline scheduler. They exist only when the application has a @Saga class (found by scanning its packages) anyway.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.max-attempts
properties.description: Attempts per saga event (first try included, >= 1) for version conflicts, start-key duplicates and handler exceptions before the event is parked in saga_failures.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.ended-retention
properties.description: Ended sagas are deleted this long after they ended (TTL index on sagas.endedAt). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.dispatch-retention
properties.description: Dispatched saga_dispatch entries are deleted this long after they were sent (TTL index on dispatchedAt). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.failed-retention
properties.description: What failed for good is deleted this long after it failed: saga_dispatch entries given up on (TTL index on failedAt) and parked events in saga_failures (TTL index on lastFailedAt). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.relay.poll-interval
properties.description: How often the dispatch relay looks for entries that saga handlers recorded. Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.relay.lease
properties.description: How long a relay instance holds one saga's dispatch order before another instance may take over (a crashed instance's lease expires). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.relay.max-attempts
properties.description: Attempts per command for transient failures (first try included, >= 1) before it becomes SagaCommandFailed(EXHAUSTED).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.relay.initial-backoff
properties.description: Wait before the second attempt of a command; doubles per attempt up to max-backoff.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.relay.max-backoff
properties.description: Upper bound of one wait between attempts of a command.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.sagas.relay.send-timeout
properties.description: How long a command send may take. One with no answer by then (a local adapter that hangs) is abandoned, its thread interrupted, and retried later with the same idempotency key as a transient failure. A send through the hub waits at least the hub's deadline for the command (its per-type override, else the request timeout or the hub's clamp) plus 10 s, so it is never sent again while the hub may still run it. Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.deadlines.poll-interval
properties.description: How often the deadline scheduler looks for due deadlines. Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.deadlines.lease
properties.description: How long a claimed deadline stays reserved for the instance that claimed it; an expired claim lets it fire again (at-least-once). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.deadlines.retention
properties.description: Fired and cancelled deadlines are deleted this long after (TTL index on deadlines.finishedAt). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.external.calls.enabled
properties.description: Whether the idempotency interceptor and the external_calls indexes exist. Unset: they exist when a class in the application's packages has an @IdempotentHandler method. Set true when the adapter lives outside those packages, false to switch it off.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.external.calls.lease
properties.description: How long an IN_PROGRESS external call may take before its outcome counts as unknown (a crash in the middle of the call). Must be positive.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.external.calls.retention
properties.description: external_calls documents older than this are deleted (TTL index on updatedAt). Must be positive.

values.description: Park in the message store's dead letters, sequence the key, DeadLetters admin API.
Publish to the event store's <source>.dlt (capability native-dead-letter).
Log and skip: nothing is parked.
